Exercise: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- quad_dominant

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- quadriceps_strength_and_hypertrophy
- calves_engagement_and_toning
- glute_activation_and_strengthening

Contraindications:

- Recent knee surgery
- Severe knee pain or instability

Exercise Variations:

- name: Front Squats With One Kettlebell, equipment: kettlebell
- name: Front Squats with Barbell, equipment: barbell

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Sumo Deadlifts with Kettlebells, equipment: kettlebells
- exercise_name: Goblet Squats, equipment: dumbbell

Instructions:

- Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
- Looking straight ahead at all times, squat as low as you can and pause at the bottom. As you squat down, push your knees out. You should squat between your legs, keeping an upright torso, with your head and chest up.
- Rise back up by driving through your heels and repeat.
